questions.question: Under which condition hunting of synchronous motor is likely to occur

explanations.a: Correct. Hunting occurs due to periodic or sudden variation of load.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Over-excitation mainly affects power factor.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Long overload may cause pull-out.
